summary: Tested homepage content-only refresh: hero intact (overline, headline, portrait, credibility), new first-person hero subcopy with rotating tagline prefix, Ask AURA hero button opens existing chat via window event, Work With Me navigates to /work-with-me, three new sections (why-i-built-aura, ask-aura-section, what-i-share) render with correct copy, ask-aura-button opens chat, chat end-to-end streams a real assistant reply via POST /api/chat (200), footer disclaimer updated, aura-chat-toggle pill works, no console errors, mobile & light-theme render new sections correctly.

issues: Document scrollWidth=402 vs clientWidth=390 -> ~12px horizontal overflow. Root cause: pre-existing decorative absolute elements inside Hero/HeroVisual (e.g. 'pointer-events-none absolute -top-40 left-1/2 w-[720px] -translate-x-1/2' glow and the Marquee/vertical accent spans) — NOT the new sections added in this change. The three new sections (why-i-built-aura, ask-aura-section, what-i-share) themselves stay within the viewport. Reporting as minor because it existed before this feature.

action_items: Optional (pre-existing, not caused by this change): clamp the hero radial glow width and hide/clip the xl-only vertical accent + marquee overflow on <sm viewports to remove the ~12px horizontal scroll at 390px. Suggest wrapping <body>/root in overflow-x-hidden or adding max-w-[100vw] to those decorative absolute divs.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx is growing large (~300 lines) with many inline section components (WhyIBuiltAura, AskAura, WhatIShare, PerspectivePreview, AboutTeaser, SpeakingStrip, FinalCTA). Consider extracting each into /components/home/*.jsx for parity with the existing pattern (Hero, Stats, Dimensions, etc.) — improves DRY and future testability.

Both hero-cta-ask-aura and ask-aura-button duplicate the same inline onClick={() => window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('aura:open-chat'))}. Extract to a tiny helper (e.g. openAuraChat()) in a shared lib to keep the event name in one place.
AuraChat window listener 'aura:open-chat' has no analytics/observability hook — consider logging source (hero vs section) via event.detail for future funnel analysis.
test_credentials: Not required for this change (frontend content-only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All feature requirements verified on desktop (1920x1080), mobile (390x844), and light theme. Chat streaming works via POST /api/chat with payload {message, history}. Only lingering observation: pre-existing ~12px horizontal scroll on mobile home caused by decorative absolute elements in Hero/HeroVisual/Marquee, unrelated to this iteration's changes.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues attributable to this iteration. Mobile horizontal scroll traced to pre-existing decorative absolute elements (hero glow w-[720px], marquee/vertical accent) via runtime DOM audit; the new sections stay within viewport.
